scale_title: How would you like to rate?
scale_subtitle: Pick whatever feels natural. You can change this later, and past records keep the scale they were taken on.
scale_numeric5_hint: Five steps. Enough room to separate values without agonising over each card.
scale_numeric10_hint: Ten steps. Finer distinctions, and a longer decision on every card.
scale_qualitative_hint: Three levels. The quickest way through the deck.
assessment_finish_partial: You can finish now — unrated values are simply left out of this record.
assessment_exit_message: Your answers so far are already saved. You can pick up where you left off.
assessment_recalibration_notice: You already calibrated today. Finishing overwrites that record.
assessment_new_record_notice: This will be saved as a new record for {{date}}.
assessment_prefilled_notice: Starting from your last answers — change what has moved.
assessment_saved_new: Saved as a new record for {{date}}.
assessment_no_values: There are no values in your deck. Restore some in Settings.
results_empty_body: Rate the value cards once and your ranking appears here.
results_row_hint: Point at a value — or tap it — to read what it means.
results_unrated_hint: {{count}} values were left unrated in this record.
history_empty_body: Your calibrations will be listed here as you record them.
history_needs_two_body: Recalibrate another day and this screen will show what moved.
history_nothing_moved: Nothing moved between these two calibrations.
history_chart_hint: Tap a value below to follow its line.
history_delete_confirm_message: The record for {{date}} and all of its ratings are removed. This cannot be undone.
settings_scale_notice: Applies to your next calibration. Records already taken keep their own scale.
settings_recalibrate_today: Today is already recorded — recalibrating overwrites it.
settings_recalibrate_past: Last calibration {{date}}. A new one today is saved as its own record.
settings_values_hint: {{active}} of {{total}} values are in the deck
values_deck_hint: Archived values stay in your past records but are not dealt in new calibrations.
deck_delete_confirm_message: It is removed from the deck along with every rating it collected. This cannot be undone.
csv_hint: Your records can be saved as a CSV file — one row per rating, readable in any spreadsheet — and read back in on another device.
csv_paste_hint: Or paste the contents of a CSV file here.
csv_export_empty_body: Finish a calibration and it can be exported.
csv_import_invalid_title: That is not a records file
csv_import_invalid_body: A records file needs a header row with assessed_on, value_key and score.
csv_import_nothing_body: No usable rows were found in that file.
csv_import_confirm_message: {{records}} calibrations, {{ratings}} ratings. A calibration you already have for the same date is replaced.
csv_import_done_values: {{count}} values were added to your deck.
reset_data_hint: Deletes every calibration and restores the default value deck.
reset_confirm_message: Every calibration and every value you added is deleted. This cannot be undone.
storage_memory_warning: This browser isn't keeping your data — it will be gone when you close the tab.
privacy_local_only_title: Your data stays on this computer
privacy_local_only: Everything you record is stored by this browser, on this computer. There is no account and no server behind this page — nothing you enter is ever sent anywhere.
value_courage_desc: To be courageous or brave; to persist in the face of fear, threat or difficulty.
value_curiosity_desc: To be curious, open-minded and interested; to explore and discover.
value_adaptability_desc: To adjust and adapt readily to changing circumstances.
value_open_mindedness_desc: To think things through, see things from other points of view, and weigh evidence fairly.
value_patience_desc: To wait calmly for what I want.
value_self_awareness_desc: To be aware of my own thoughts, feelings and actions.
value_learning_desc: To keep growing, advancing or improving in knowledge, skills, character or life experience.
value_self_control_desc: To act in accordance with my own ideals.
value_connection_desc: To engage fully in whatever I am doing, and be fully present with others.
value_cooperation_desc: To be cooperative and collaborative with others.
value_friendliness_desc: To be friendly, companionable or agreeable towards others.
value_forgiveness_desc: To be forgiving towards myself or others.
value_intimacy_desc: To open up, reveal and share myself, emotionally or physically.
value_love_desc: To act lovingly or affectionately towards myself or others.
value_respect_desc: To be respectful towards myself and others; to be considerate and show positive regard.
value_diligence_desc: To be industrious, hard-working and dedicated.
value_persistence_desc: To continue resolutely, despite problems or difficulties.
value_mastery_desc: To continually practise and improve my skills, and apply myself fully when using them.
value_acceptance_desc: To be open to and accepting of myself, others, and life.
value_health_desc: To maintain or improve my fitness; to look after my physical and mental health and wellbeing.
value_humour_desc: To be fun-loving; to seek, create and engage in fun-filled activities.
value_mindfulness_desc: To be conscious of, open to and curious about my here-and-now experience.
value_sensuality_desc: To create, explore and enjoy experiences that stimulate the five senses.
value_sexuality_desc: To explore or express my sexuality.
value_caring_desc: To be caring towards myself, others, and the environment.
value_compassion_desc: To act with kindness towards myself and others who are suffering.
value_generosity_desc: To contribute, help, assist, share and make a positive difference to myself or others.
value_encouragement_desc: To encourage and reward behaviour that I value in myself or others.
value_kindness_desc: To be kind, considerate, nurturing or caring towards myself or others.
value_helping_desc: To be supportive, helpful and available to myself or others.
value_equality_desc: To treat others as equal to myself, and vice versa.
value_reciprocity_desc: To build relationships in which there is a fair balance of giving and taking.
value_adventure_desc: To be adventurous; to actively seek, create, or explore novel or stimulating experiences.
value_assertiveness_desc: To respectfully stand up for my rights and request what I want.
value_freedom_desc: To live freely; to choose how I live and behave, or help others do likewise.
value_excitement_desc: To seek, create and engage in activities that are exciting, stimulating or thrilling.
value_honesty_desc: To be honest, truthful and sincere with myself and others.
value_responsibility_desc: To be responsible and accountable for my actions.
value_safety_desc: To secure, protect or ensure the safety of myself or others.
value_conformity_desc: To be respectful and obedient of rules and obligations.
value_trustworthiness_desc: To be trustworthy; to be loyal, faithful, sincere and reliable.
value_authenticity_desc: To be authentic, genuine and real; to be true to myself.
value_gratitude_desc: To be grateful for and appreciative of myself, others and life.
value_humility_desc: To be humble or modest; to let my achievements speak for themselves.
value_spirituality_desc: To connect with things bigger than myself.
